mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the capillary sprout was most worthwhile: seeing it join another vessel showed how blood reaches the healing cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the prepared pieces into the body felt repetitive after making them, even though it showed where they belonged.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected clot removal to be a separate final goal; it helped distinguish temporary clot threads from the fibres that remain.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures explained the repair pieces, though the later slot fittings were predictable.

continue.text: Probably not right away. The repair sequence was clear and satisfying, but fitting each prepared piece became repetitive.
